faq_heading: Fleetwood Tynehead condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Fleetwood Tynehead. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Fleetwood Tynehead, Surrey: 136 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 15 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 3 of 15 Surrey communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Surrey total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Fleetwood Tynehead fell from 143 in June to 136 in September (−4.9%), and 69 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 8.9% of Surrey’s 1,523 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Fleetwood Tynehead?
Fleetwood Tynehead also had 137 houses listed and 14 sold in September, against 136 condos and townhomes listed. The Fleetwood Tynehead houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: Fleetwood Tynehead home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

158 townhomes sold in Fleetwood Tynehead with a median price of $800,000 (the middle half sold between $726,625 and $844,500), taking a median of 24 days to sell at 97.6% of the last list price; 9% sold above list. They had a median $505 per square foot, a median year built of 2008 and a median strata fee of $408 a month. 41 condos sold in Fleetwood Tynehead with a median price of $510,000 (the middle half sold between $439,900 and $590,000), taking a median of 32 days to sell at 97.8% of the last list price; 7% sold above list. They had a median $670 per square foot, a median year built of 2022 and a median strata fee of $415 a month.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Fleetwood Tynehead?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 136 condos and townhomes listed in Fleetwood Tynehead. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Fleetwood Tynehead a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Fleetwood Tynehead had a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Fleetwood Tynehead from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 69 condos and townhomes sold in Fleetwood Tynehead over those 4 months, out of 591 in all of Surrey.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Fleetwood Tynehead sell for?
faq.a: 158 townhomes sold in Fleetwood Tynehead between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $800,000.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Fleetwood Tynehead?
faq.a: The median was 24 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.6% of the last list price (9% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
